title: Local internal module-object derived Hom and restriction comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its small pro-etale site, Λ a commutative condensed ring, B=p_X^*Λ its coefficient ring object and A its category of internal module objects, with the global section-action derived equivalence and normalized tensor comparison of [def-sfb-internal-section-derived-tensor-comparison]. For every U in the site, let B_U=B|_U be the literal restricted commutative ring object [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and A_U its actual module-object category [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Its reconstructed section ring equals B_sec|_U; the section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] is additive, giving E_U=D(F_U) on the ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Define internal restriction as E_U^{-1} r D(F), with its section comparison the equivalence counit. Use the framework's NATIVE K-flat derived relative tensor on D(A_U), its NATIVE MonoidalClosed.internalHom and the native adjunction counit [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]; none is transported from a chosen ringed-site closed structure. The native monoidal instance equals its K-flat localization instance, which supplies the actual Koszul braiding; write its evaluation with Hom as first tensor factor using this braiding. For local internal complexes P,Q, the canonical sum-total comparison with the sectionwise total is uniquely characterized on EVERY summand p+q=n by the ordinary section-action pure-tensor comparison, with the reconstructed and restricted section-ring presentations identified by their equality. For a local K-injective Hom H_U [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], closed ringed data S_U and K-flat models T_U [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], define a SliceTensorComparison to be a natural isomorphism from E_U of the NATIVE local derived tensor to S_U.tensor(E_U(-),E_U(-)), whose localization square on EVERY pair of complexes with K-flat section images is the canonical sum-total comparison followed by T_U's K-flat comparison. Given such a t_U, normalized ringed restriction data d [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model] and a global Hom comparison θ, a SliceHomComparison consists of θ^U:E_U RHom^{A_U}_{B_U}≅H_U(E_U(-),E_U(-)), natural in ALL local derived objects, and its evaluation equation using the NATIVE local counit and t_U. It also contains a natural module-side restriction isomorphism r_U:r_int RHom^A_B≅RHom^{A_U}_{B_U}(r_int(-),r_int(-)). Its compatibility square says E_U(r_U), then θ^U and the Hom map of the restriction-section counits, equals the restriction-section counit at RHom^A_B, then r(θ), then d.eta. Thus r_U is the unique fully faithful lift of the square, whereas θ^U and t_U compare the independently given NATIVE structures. The same evaluation and restriction equations are also named as generic predicates on their category and functor endpoints; specializing these predicates to the canonical functors and native evaluations gives exactly the displayed conditions.
